text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
The Needle Series—the grand stage<n>where
humans augmented by<n>acupuncture race each
other for ultimate<n>supremacy.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Today will be our first step towards<n>conquering
that series—the day of the<n>Bamboo Stakes.
choice_data_list: This should be the meeting place...

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Beauty
text_block_list.text:
Oh! <username>,<n>please help
meee!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course! I knew it, I'm just not mewithout my charismatic Miracle ShiningSunglasses!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Oh, absolutely! Without them, I havenothing but worries! For a geniusacupuncturist-slash-trainer like me,they're almost as important as life itself!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
But alas! They got blown by the wind<n>into the
back of a truck, then the truck<n>carried them far,
far away, then they<n>were picked up by a stray
dog—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Sadly, yes... Sniffle... Please, you musthelp me...

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, there's still time until I have<n>to run in
the Bamboo Stakes, so Sasami<n>Anshinzawa and I
decide to look for her<n>sunglasses together.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: They're not here...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Nor here...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Or even here...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look! The dog underneath the<n>overpass!
That's the one!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I've finally caught up to you now! Return<n>my
sunglasses at once!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
They're a family heirloom, and um... also<n>
represent the wearer's determination to<n>be a
beacon of reassurance to<n>Umamusume!
choice_data_list: Those glasses have such deep lore!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
In the Legend of the Anshinzawas... It<n>was, uh...
Yasuzaemon Anshinzawa? Who<n>said something
along those lines!<n>Probably! ♪

text_block_list.name: Stray Dog
text_block_list.text: Grrrrrowl!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Right as the stray dog poises to strike, I<n>seize the
opportunity and snatch the<n>sunglasses away!

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Even stray dogs are no match for me<n>now... I bask
in my feeling of<n>accomplishment as I hand the
sunglasses<n>back to Sasami Anshinzawa.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Swoon... ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Phew, looks like we somehow made it on<n>time. ♪
Feeling ready?
choice_data_list: To tell you the truth, I'm a bit nervous...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course you would be! This is where<n>my needles
come in handy! Let me give<n>your Courageous
Challenger chakra a<n>little poke! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't be shy! It's Мой путь of saying<n>thanks for
recovering my family<n>heirloom! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Here I go! Annnd poke!

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text: Puncture Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Strangely enough, as soon as she pokes<n>me, all
feelings of doubt disappear from<n>my mind, and an
abundance of power<n>wells up in me!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Wow! I really did it! I knew it was worth<n>a shot! ♪

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text: I start towards the race track in high<n>spirits, but...

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
As soon as she pokes me, my anxiety<n>begins to
grow in intensity. At this rate, I<n>feel like my
nervousness will completely<n>overwhelm me!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: W-wait... Did that not work? It didn't?!
choice_data_list: D-don't worry, I'll win with sheer determination!

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
I quickly start towards the race track in<n>an
attempt to shake off the heavy<n>feeling, but...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Hold on! I have something for you!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Hold on! I have something for you!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Here! Take my Miracle Shining<n>Sunglasses! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you look great in them! ♪ With<n>those on,
you'll have nothing to worry<n>about!
choice_data_list: But aren't these really important to you?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
No need to hold back! We've been<n>through thick
and thin together! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly why I feel confident<n>entrusting
them to you! ☆ Get out there<n>and break a leg!

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
The sunglasses bestowed upon me<n>imbue my body
with great strength!

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
I've heard stories of signature racewear<n>bringing
out the wearer's inner strength,<n>which means...
choice_data_list:
(These sunglasses must be my very own
signature racewear!)

(These sunglasses must be my very own
signature racewear!)

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that Sasami Anshinzawa is<n>cheering me
on from the stands, I run<n>with all my might in
hopes of winning the<n>trophy for her!

text_block_list.name: Комментатор
text_block_list.text:
In a magnificent performance,<n>
<chrname>'s trainer has<n>crossed the
finish line in first place!

text_block_list.name: Комментатор
text_block_list.text:
Like a shooting star, he's appeared out<n>of
nowhere and taken the Bamboo<n>Stakes by storm!

text_block_list.name: Комментатор
text_block_list.text:
Like a shooting star, she's appeared out<n>of
nowhere and taken the Bamboo<n>Stakes by storm!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yesss! You did it,<n>
<username>!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I knew you'd be able to do it, partner! ♪<n>Time to
keep winning all the way to the<n>top!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to get another pair of those<n>sunglasses
from the dollar store too! ☆
